reply.style_block: An intimate visual style using soft natural morning light, muted earthy tones, textured film grain, and realistic medium-shot photography evoking a personal documentary.
reply.world_block: Any person is depicted only from behind or in shadow to protect their identity, wearing traditional Ethiopian highlands cotton attire. Any village home is a small dwelling with a corrugated tin roof and a vibrant blue wooden door. Any field of the crop is a lush coffee plant with dark green leaves and bright red cherries, distinct from broadleaf plants.
reply.reference_sheet_prompt: A cinematic reference sheet showing a weathered blue wooden door on a tin-roofed house, a clay coffee pot, fresh green grass on a dirt floor, and a lone figure seen from behind in soft morning light.
